subject: FW: Pricing for pilot & request for commercial exception (BlueHeron Therapeutics)
messages:
From: Avery Cole <avery.cole@blueheronthera.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@blueheronthera.com
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing for pilot & initial SOW

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BlueHeron is keen to run a focused pilot around our pathology triage workflow (approx. 1M tokens/month peak). Procurement asked me to send a simple SOW and an ask on target pricing so we can scope internal approvals. High level: 3-month pilot, option to convert to 12-month committed contract.

Key asks:
- A pilot price that keeps run costs predictable while we validate throughput/latency.
- A clause for outcome-based conversion (discount applied to committed term if conversion happens).

Attached is a short SOW and our internal checklist. Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf

Best,
Avery
Avery Cole
Director, Product Partnerships
BlueHeron Therapeutics
avery.cole@blueheronthera.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Pricing for pilot & request for commercial exception (BlueHeron Therapeutics)

Team — forwarding BlueHeron request and SOW. Short ask: they want a low-friction 3-month pilot with optional conversion to a 12-month commitment. Commercial wants an upfront pilot price we can defend to RevOps/Finance.

Why I recommend an exception:
- Strategic: BlueHeron is a Tier-1 pathology ISV with enterprise reach; potential multi-product integration and co-marketing.
- Technical fit: predictable latency requirements map well to our Dedicated routing; low operational risk.
- Commercial trade: they will commit to a 12-month conversion and are open to a usage-based true-up.

Recommended concession (requesting VP/CFO signoff):
- Pilot pricing: 35% off list for first 3 months (applied to token usage & embeddings).
- Conversion guarantee: if they convert to a 12-month commitment within 45 days of pilot end, we keep the concession for month 1 of the committed term and revert to standard tiering after true-up.
- Margin protection: add a floor of $0.005 per token equivalent after quantization/efficiency adjustments.
- Operational guardrails: cap burst at 1.5x committed baseline without additional credits; overages bill at list.

Attachments: commercial_summary_blueheron.xlsx, redline_contract_v2.pdf

Ask: Markus/Marissa — can we get conditional signoff on the 35% pilot concession and the floor/guardrails above? If approved I will send an updated SOW + approved memo to procurement and include the HubSpot deal link.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Pricing for pilot & request for commercial exception (BlueHeron Therapeutics)

Vanessa —

I support the concession as long as we keep explicit margin protection and a clear true-up path. A couple of quick asks for the memo:
- Add a 30-day true-up window post-conversion for usage reconciliation.
- Limit promotional credits to pilot only (no carry into committed term).

If RevOps/Finance are happy with the floor and true-up language, I think we can move quickly.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 17:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: FW: Pricing for pilot & request for commercial exception (BlueHeron Therapeutics)

Vanessa / team —

I approve a conditional 35% pilot concession with the following executive clarifications:
1) Margin floor: keep $0.005 per token equivalent as proposed. Any downward adjustment requires explicit RevOps sign-off.
2) True-up: 30-day reconciliation window after conversion; any shortfall billed to BlueHeron at list.
3) Promotional scope: credits limited to the pilot and cannot be carried into the committed term.
4) Escrow / conversion clause: include a DocuSign checklist for conversion triggers and a 60-day notice period for conversion to allow legal/infra coordination.

Marissa — please prepare the short approval memo (one page) documenting the commercial exception and add the HubSpot deal id. Vanessa — once Marissa flags the memo I want Legal to review the redline_contract_v2.pdf and confirm the escrow language.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
